blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Edge Cloud Technology and Solutions (ECTS) successfully held Edge Cloud Partner Connects 2026 on September 16, 2026, bringing together IT companies, business leaders, prospective resellers, and technology partners for a day centered on collaboration, innovation, and new business opportunities. The event provided participants with a closer look at Edge Cloud’s portfolio of business technology solutions, including Partnership Tier Program, Deal Registration and Cloud Infrastructure and other IT solutions designed to support organizations in an increasingly digital business environment. The successful gathering reflects Edge Cloud Technology and Solutions’ continuing efforts to develop a stronger partner ecosystem in Cebu and across the region. […]...
